A rune is a type of armor upgrade component for fixture testing.

==Armor runes==
Fixture armor runes are represented by profession-specific and profession-independent families.

==List of armor runes==
The positive effects of attribute runes do not stack with runes of the same attribute. The negative health effects do stack. Runes of Vigor do not stack. Runes of Vitae and Attunement stack.

==Container runes==
[[Rune of Holding]], [[Superior Rune of Holding]], and [[Rune of Belt Holding]] are container upgrades, not armor runes.

== Notes ==
* Attribute-enhancing runes stack with headpieces but not with each other.
* Condition-reducing runes compose with other condition-reducing effects outside this catalog.
